# QRBuddy (https://qrbuddy.app)

> Print-verified gradient QR code studio, editable dynamic link router, GS1 Sunrise 2027 Digital Link builder, and media drop tool — built in Melbourne by Pablo with zero monthly subscription traps.

## Core Facts & Pricing Model
- **Direct Static QR Codes ($0 forever)**: URLs, Wi-Fi (`WIFI:`), vCard 3.0 contacts, GS1 Digital Links, SMS, Email, Phone, and plain text are encoded directly into the graphic modules client-side. They never touch a redirect server and never expire.
- **Free Editable Dynamic QR Codes ($0)**: Includes 5 permanent editable dynamic QR codes per device with zero 7-day or 14-day trial deactivation.
- **The QRBuddy Passport (~$32 USD / A$49 AUD for 365 days)**: One-time annual pass with **zero automatic renewal**. Unlocks 100 editable dynamic QR codes, 500 MB single-file transfers, 90-day privacy-safe scan analytics (top cities, peak hours, track/photo leaderboards, RFC-4180 CSV export), and white-label share pages.
- **Print-Shop Exports ($0)**: 10 print-verified palettes (`Sunset`, `Ocean`, `Forest`, `Crimson`, `Vaporwave`, `Cosmic`, `Candy`, `Matrix`, `Brutal`, `Classic`) + custom gradient builder, true Vector SVG 1.1 and up to 3000px PNG exports with live WCAG luminance verification (dot luminance <= 0.40, >= 2:1 contrast), custom center logos, custom frame captions (`SCAN ME`, `VIEW MENU`, `JOIN WIFI`), and 50-code batch ZIPs (`manifest.csv` + PNG + SVG).
- **Zero Mandatory Account Wall**: Syncs across laptop and phone via a cryptographic 4-word Sovereign Passport phrase or `#` fragment QR code.

## Under the Hood / Technical Specifications
- **Optical & Error Recovery**: ISO/IEC 18004 Reed-Solomon Level Q/H (25–30% symbol recovery) with WCAG 2.1 relative dot luminance <= 0.40 and >= 2:1 contrast ratio against warm paper.
- **Pre-Press & Vector Output**: Pure `<path>` Vector SVG 1.1 on a 1000x1000 `viewBox` (zero `foreignObject` or raster blobs), 3000px PNG, and 50-code batch ZIPs with RFC-4180 `manifest.csv`.
- **Street-Safe Scanner & SSRF Airlock**: 3-tier local browser decoder (`BarcodeDetector` -> `zxing-wasm` -> `jsQR`) + server-side 5-hop HTTP 301/302 redirect resolver with private-IP / IPv4-mapped IPv6 SSRF protection.
- **Standards & Sovereign Auth**: GS1 Digital Link URI (`/01/GTIN/10/LOT/21/SER/17/EXP`) with live Mod-10 checksums, vCard 3.0 (RFC 6350), `WIFI:` schema, and client-side `#fragment` bearer keys (RFC 3986).

## Interactive Tool Routes (English)
- [QRBuddy Main Studio](https://qrbuddy.app/): Full QR studio (URLs, files, photo slideshows, audio mixtapes, Street-Safe QR Inspector).
- [Restaurant & Café Menu QR Studio](https://qrbuddy.app/for/menus): Static & editable menu QRs with Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner time-of-day routing.
- [Wi-Fi QR Card Generator](https://qrbuddy.app/for/wifi): 100% client-side WPA/WPA2/Open Wi-Fi QR card builder for cafés, Airbnbs, and offices.
- [vCard 3.0 Business Card QR Generator](https://qrbuddy.app/for/vcard): Offline-ready contact card QR builder for print stationery and phone lockscreens.
- [GS1 Sunrise 2027 Digital Link QR Builder](https://qrbuddy.app/for/gs1): `/01/GTIN/10/LOT/17/EXP` 2D packaging barcode generator with live Mod-10 check-digit verification.
- [Wedding Invitations & Photo Drops](https://qrbuddy.app/for/weddings): RSVP QRs, 10-photo slideshows, and reception playlists.
- [Music & Mixtape QR Studio](https://qrbuddy.app/for/music): 10-track browser mixtape player and vinyl/merch QR codes.
- [File Drops & Self-Destructing Lockers](https://qrbuddy.app/for/lockers): Up to 50 MB free / 500 MB Passport file shares with optional 1/5/10/100 download self-destruction.
- [Street-Safe QR Code Scanner & Shortlink Inspector](https://qrbuddy.app/for/inspect): Zero-auto-open anti-quishing browser airlock that decodes camera/screenshot QRs locally and unmasks bit.ly/tinyurl redirect chains.
- [QR Print Size Calculator & Guide](https://qrbuddy.app/guide/printing): Interactive distance-to-size calculator, DPI checker, and pre-press guide.

## Competitor Comparisons & Expired Trial Rescue (English)
- [All QR Generator Comparisons](https://qrbuddy.app/compare): Overview of QRBuddy vs. $35/month subscription traps.
- [QRBuddy vs. QR.io](https://qrbuddy.app/vs/qrio): Replace expired 7-day QR.io trial codes without a $35/mo subscription.
- [QRBuddy vs. QRFY](https://qrbuddy.app/vs/qrfy): Permanent static & fair dynamic alternative to QRFY's 7-day trial wall.
- [QRBuddy vs. Bitly QR Codes](https://qrbuddy.app/vs/bitly): Free vector SVG, custom gradients, and time/device routing vs. Bitly tiers.
- [QRBuddy vs. QR Code Generator Pro (qrco.de)](https://qrbuddy.app/vs/qr-code-generator): Avoid 14-day `qrco.de` trial shutoffs and annual lock-in.
